definition: Sale-start Pacific calendar date minus source-reported release date; date-resolution days.
source: frozen cohort release_date; existing deterministic master/pilot selection metadata

definition: Year of the normalized source-reported release date.
source: frozen cohort release_date; existing deterministic master/pilot selection metadata

definition: Month (1–12) of the normalized source-reported release date.
source: frozen cohort release_date; existing deterministic master/pilot selection metadata

definition: Quarter (1–4) of the normalized source-reported release date.
source: frozen cohort release_date; existing deterministic master/pilot selection metadata

definition: Count of independently parser-valid pre-cutoff Steam price observations; duplicates retained.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Never null; zero means no parser-valid pre-cutoff price observations.

definition: Count of qualifying discounted observations among prior_price_record_count; not campaigns.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Never null; zero means no qualifying pre-cutoff discount observations.

definition: prior_discount_count / prior_price_record_count; observation-level ratio, not discounted-day share.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Null when no valid prior price observations; zero if prices exist but no discounts were observed.

definition: Elapsed UTC days since latest valid pre-cutoff price observation.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Null when no valid prior price observation; never zero-filled.

definition: Elapsed UTC days since latest qualifying pre-cutoff discount observation.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Null when no qualifying prior discount observation; never zero-filled.

definition: Maximum explicit cut percentage among qualifying pre-cutoff discounts.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Null when no qualifying prior discount observation.

definition: Arithmetic mean explicit cut percentage among qualifying pre-cutoff discounts.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Null when no qualifying prior discount observation.

definition: Amount at latest valid pre-cutoff observation, only with exclusively USD prior valid prices and no latest-timestamp conflict.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Null for no valid prior price, mixed/non-USD prior currencies, or conflicting latest timestamp.

definition: Explicit cut at latest valid pre-cutoff observation; null for conflicting latest timestamp.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Null for no valid prior price or conflicting latest timestamp.

definition: 1 if at least one valid pre-cutoff price observation exists, otherwise 0.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Never null; zero denotes no valid pre-cutoff price observations, not full-history emptiness.

definition: 1 if at least one qualifying pre-cutoff discount observation exists, otherwise 0.
source: cached ITAD Steam shop 61 / US; shared Phase 5A.1 parser
missing_value_meaning: Never null; zero denotes no recorded qualifying pre-cutoff discount, not proof of no discount.
